en: James 3

p.src: 1  Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

ja: たち、あなたがたのうち
になってはなりません。教師である
たちは、いっそう厳しい
en: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.
u.src: 1  Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

p.src: 2  For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

en: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.
u.src: 2  For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

p.src: 3  Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

ja: にくつわをはめれば、私たちは馬の
を操ることができます。
en: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.
u.src: 3  Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

p.src: 4  Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

ja: に吹かれていても、ごく
en: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.
u.src: 4  Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

ja: 3:4 「見よ」はギリシャ語の「ἰδοὺ」に由来し、「見る」「注意を向ける」「よく観察する」「じっと見る」という意味があり、間投詞としてよく使われる。
en: 3:4 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 5  So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

en: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!
u.src: 5  So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

p.src: 6  And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

ja: にあって、不義の世界そのものです。
がらせ、自らもゲヘナによって
en: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.
u.src: 6  And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

en: 3:6 or, Hell

p.src: 7  For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

ja: を飼いならすことができ、実際に飼いならしてきました。
en: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;
u.src: 7  For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

p.src: 8  but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

ja: を飼いならすことのできる
は一人もいません。舌は静まることのない
en: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
u.src: 8  but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

p.src: 9  With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

ja: である方をほめたたえ、
en: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.
u.src: 9  With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

p.src: 10  Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

ja: たち、そうであってはなりません。
en: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.
u.src: 10  Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

p.src: 11  Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

en: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?
u.src: 11  Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

p.src: 12  Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

ja: がいちじくの実を結んだりできるでしょうか。同じように、
en: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.
u.src: 12  Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

p.src: 13  Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

ja: があり、物事をよく理解している
en: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.
u.src: 13  Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

p.src: 14  But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

ja: に激しいねたみと利己的な野心があるなら、
en: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.
u.src: 14  But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

p.src: 15  This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

ja: し、人間の本能に根ざし、
en: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.
u.src: 15  This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

p.src: 16  For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

ja: ねたみと利己的な野心のあるところには、
en: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.
u.src: 16  For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

p.src: 17  But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

ja: をもたらし、穏やかで、道理をわきまえ、あわれみと
en: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
u.src: 17  But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

p.src: 18  Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

en: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
u.src: 18  Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
